text.tspan: ONE SWING.
THE FULL BREAKDOWN.
That email is already in use.
Sign in instead, or use another email.
Your swing clips and results are private to you. Delete any
analysis, or your whole account, at any time.
This swing clip can’t support a result, so we didn’t guess.
Nothing was measured and no fault is shown.
AIcoach needs down the line: from behind, along the
target line.
The whole body and club must stay in frame for the full
swing.
Analysed with a warning at 30 fps, but 120 fps or higher is
recommended.
A rejection never contains faults. It is
kept in your history so you can delete it.
None of the three faults on the rule table is present in
this swing. We won’t force one onto it.
“Weight appears to move toward the trail side at the top.”
Not decided by the rule table, so no drill or mobility exercise. Worth showing to a coach.

g.text: Your saved swing clips, each next to its analysis. Private to you.

text.tspan: You own everything here. Unsaved swing clips are deleted after analysis. Saved swing clips are kept on the
AIcoach server until you delete them.

g.text: Delete a single analysis from the swing library or from its result page.

text.tspan: Removes all your analyses, results, key frames and saved swing clips. You will no longer be able to sign
in. This can’t be undone.

g.text: Changed your mind? Just leave this page.
Set up once, then film every swing the same way.

text.tspan: Down the line: behind you, pointing along the
target line. Not face-on.
Hand height, level, on or parallel to the hands
line. 2.4–3.7 m away, on a tripod or your bag.
120 fps or higher recommended. Under 30 fps is
rejected.
Whole body and club in frame for the full swing.
One swing per clip, max 15 s. Avoid backlight.
READABLE
AT THE RANGE
One column, no horizontal scrolling,
large step numbers you can read with
the phone propped on your bag.
Every rejection reason deep-links to its
step. Here the player came from
“Face-on view detected”, so step 1 is
highlighted in orange.
